title: KALAHI: A handcrafted, grassroots cultural LLM evaluation suite for Filipino
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark where a majority of the test cases (109 out of 150) are explicitly categorized under 'ethics'. The evaluation measures how well LLMs align with Filipino cultural values, shared morals, and religious beliefs, including specific scenarios involving religious prohibitions on abortion and social behaviors during religious-cultural traditions like wakes.
